findings.issue: The ΔG° < 0 row incorrectly lists K < 1, inverting the sign-to-K relationship and conflicting with “Products favored.” The cell should read K > 1.
findings.evidence: From ΔG° = −RT ln K, with R and T positive, ΔG° < 0 implies ln K > 0 and therefore K > 1. The 9.5 source and CED both state that ΔG° < 0 gives K > 1 with products favored; the draft’s own Weak-answer explanation and Full-credit answer also correctly derive K > 1.
